title: recover-P: c31p2 with balanced abort limits (node cap 2^32.65, meter 2^125): expected work 2^112.648625088781

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^114.0070040376+2^66) < 2^112.648625088781 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7194604308170750010, (K/2^64) x 0.999948 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.999948 and costs at most 2^125.000681035001 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
